flowerbonemeal.config.title: Flower Bone Meal Duplication
flowerbonemeal.option.mod_enabled.toolti:
Yes: bone meal makes flowers drop a copy of themselves.
No: the mod is switched off and bone meal works exactly like vanilla.
flowerbonemeal.option.mangrove_propagule:
Yes: bone meal on a mangrove propagule drops a copy.
No: vanilla behaviour (it grows toward a mangrove tree).
Also applies to modded plants that grow in stages like it.
flowerbonemeal.option.azalea.tooltip:
Flowering Only: flowering azalea drops a copy; regular azalea grows a tree.
Flowering and Regular: both drop a copy (no trees from bone meal).
Neither: both grow an azalea tree (vanilla).
flowerbonemeal.option.torchflower_pitche:
Yes: bone meal on a torchflower or pitcher plant drops a copy.
No: vanilla behaviour (bone meal does nothing to them).
flowerbonemeal.option.wither_golden: Wither Rose & Golden Dandelion Drop Copy
flowerbonemeal.option.wither_golden.tool:
Wither Rose Only: only wither roses drop a copy.
Golden Dandelion Only: only golden dandelions drop a copy.
Both: both drop a copy.
Off: neither does (vanilla).
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.flowerbon: Bone meal makes flowers drop a copy of themselves, filling the gaps vanilla leaves.
